senses.gloss: Kāka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 372 (only B., C. has Kāntīkāḥ).
Kākī^1 (“female crow”). § 126 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2620 (daughter of Tāmrā), 2621 (mother of the owls).
Kākī^2, one of the mothers of Śiśu. § 500 (Skandopākh.): III, 228, 14396 (enumeration).
Kaksha, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 356, 364 (only C., B. has Kacchāḥ).
Kakshaka, a serpent. § 63 (Sarpasattra): I, 57, 2147 (of Vāsuki's race).

Kakshasena, name of one or more princes. § 154 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3743 (son of the elder Parikshit).--§ 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 117 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).-§ 267 (Yamasabhāv.): II, 8, 329 (in the palace of Yama).-§ 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 89, 8365 (āśramaḥ Kºsya, in the west).--§ 767 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 137, 6259 ºo rājarshiḥ Vaśishṭhāya mahātmane nyāsaṃ yathāvat saṃnyasya jagāma sumahāyaśāḥ).--§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7685 (rājarshiḥ, enumeration).--§ 786 (Anugītāp.): XIV, 91, 2843 (had attained to high success by way of gifts).
Kaksheyu, a prince. § 150 (Pūruvaṃś.): I, 94, 3700 (son of Raudrāśva and Ghṛtācī).--§ 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 166, 7682 (the same?).
Kākshīva = Kākshīvat. § 277 (Jarāsandhavadhap.): II, 21, 802 (śūdrāyāṃ Gautamo yatra--i.e. at Rājagṛha--mahātmā saṃśitavrataḥ | Auśīnaryām ajanayat Kºādyān sutān muniḥ, cf. I, 4213).

Kakshīvat, a ṛshi. § 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7108 (Aushijaḥ (B. Auśº), among the Mahendraguravaḥ in the east). --§ 775 (do.): XIII, 166, 7663 (Aushijaḥ (B. Auśº), among the ṛshis of the east). Cf. next and prec.

Kākshīvat = Kakshīvat. § 5 (Anukram.): I, 1, 224 (in Nārada's enumeration of ancient kings (!), B. has Auśijaṃ for Mahādyutiṃ, which follows in C.).--§ 170 (Dīrghatamas): I, 104, 4213 (ºādayaḥ, K., etc., were begotten by Dīrghatamas on a śūdrā), 4215.--§ 264 (Sabhākriyāp): II, 4, 112 (Aushijaḥ (B. Auśº) waited upon Yudhishṭhira).--§ 266 (Śakrasabhāv.): II, 7, 299 (Gautamaḥ? in the palace of Indra).--§ 275 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 17, 698 (ºtaḥ putraṃ Gautamasya…Caṇḍakauśikaṃ).--§ 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 84, 8083 (ºān iva modate, sc. by bathing at Rājagṛha).--§ 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7593 (Aushijaḥ (B. Auśº), among the ṛshis of the east).--§ 702 (do.): XII, 293, 10761 (had obtained great success by adoring Vishṇu); 297, 10874 (ºKamaṭhādayaḥ, among those ṛshis who had obtained their position by way of penances). Cf. the prec.
Kākshīvatī (“a female descendant of Kakshīvat”) = Bhadrā: I, 4695.
Kākudika, name of a weapon. § 563 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 96, 3490 (will be employed by Arjuna).
Kakutstha, an ancient king in Ayodhyā. § 6 (Anukram.): I, 1, 226 (in Sañjaya's enumeration of departed kings).-§ 475 (Dhundhumārop.): III, 202, 13516 (son of Śaśāda and father of Anenas).
Kākutstha^3 (do.) = Lakshmaṇa, the son of Daśaratha: III, 16207.
